purpose: Test whether chunking, simple retrieval baselines, cross-domain comparison, and uncertainty reporting materially change conclusions before investing in model- or human-dependent studies.

chunking_treatments.description: One retrieval unit per complete paper.
One retrieval unit per pinned PDF page.
Combine normalized complete-paper and best-page evidence.

retrieval_treatments.description: Character-trigram TF-IDF baseline for terminology and identifier robustness.
Reciprocal-rank fusion of the two simple baselines.

registered_decision_rules.supported_when: At least one non-document chunker changes Recall@10 by at least 0.02 versus the same retriever's document treatment in either domain.
registered_decision_rules.strong_support_when: The paired 95% bootstrap interval for that change excludes zero.
registered_decision_rules.important_limit: This phase does not implement neural late chunking or a learned hierarchical chunker.

registered_decision_rules.supported_when: The point winner differs by domain or more than one treatment remains on the cross-domain quality-latency Pareto frontier.
registered_decision_rules.important_limit: The phase compares lexical, fuzzy lexical, and hybrid baselines; it does not claim a semantic-embedding baseline.

registered_decision_rules.supported_when: At least one treatment has a Recall@10 bootstrap interval at least 0.05 wide, showing material finite-query uncertainty.
registered_decision_rules.important_limit: Bootstrap uncertainty across exposed questions does not estimate provider, judge, or generation variance.

deferred_registered_proposals.reason: Requires claim-level answer annotations and grounded generations.
Requires blinded human annotations and judge perturbation trials.
Requires genuinely new source bytes and untouched question authors.
Requires a future search delta and independent screening.
Requires a dedicated SHACL mutation corpus.
Requires re-expressing one existing evolution as a component contract.
Requires visually reviewed PDF extraction fixtures.
